name: Update Child Block
description: Updates a child block object. [See the documentation](https://developers.notion.com/reference/update-a-block)

configurable_props.name: blockId
configurable_props.label: Block ID
configurable_props.description: Block ID retrieved from the **Retrieve Page Content** action

configurable_props.name: infoLabel
configurable_props.content: **Note:** The update replaces the entire value for a given field. If a field is omitted (ex: omitting checked when updating a to_do block), the value will not be changed.

configurable_props.name: content
configurable_props.label: Content
configurable_props.description: The content of the block. **E.g. {"code": {"rich_text":[{"type":"text","text":{"content":"Updated content"}}]}}** [See the documentation](https://developers.notion.com/reference/update-a-block)
